en.headline: Guangdong yachts to make first southbound voyage on 16 October
en.dek: The Transport and Logistics Bureau and Marine Department will hold a first-voyage ceremony next Friday to welcome the initial batch of Guangdong-registered yachts under the new reciprocal arrangement.
body: Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said on Saturday that the Transport and Logistics Bureau and the Marine Department will hold a first-voyage ceremony for “Guangdong yachts southbound” on 16 October.

In a blog post, Chan described the move as a maritime counterpart to the existing arrangement that allows Hong Kong yachts to sail north into Guangdong waters. She said more details would be announced later.

The Marine Department and the Guangdong Maritime Safety Administration signed two work arrangements at the end of last month to facilitate cross-boundary yacht visits in both directions. The ceremony next Friday will welcome the first batch of Guangdong-registered yachts arriving under the new rules.

Chan also noted that Hong Kong recorded more than 1.6 million visitor arrivals during the recent National Day Golden Week, including over 1.41 million from the mainland. She said the new Huanggang Port will open to the public at 6.30am on 12 October, while cross-boundary road traffic continues to grow.

Authorities are discussing with Guangdong the gradual expansion of days when Hong Kong private cars travelling north need not make advance bookings, from the current Tuesday and Wednesday arrangement to other non-peak weekdays.

zh.headline: 「粵艇南下」首航儀式定於10月16日舉行
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，運輸及物流局與海事處將於下周五舉行「粵艇南下」首航儀式，迎接首批廣東遊艇來港。
body: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶周六在網誌透露，運輸及物流局與海事處將於10月16日舉行「粵艇南下」首航儀式。
陳美寶形容，此舉是在「港艇北上」基礎上，迎來海上版的雙向往來。她預告稍後會公布更多具體細節。
海事處與廣東海事局上月底已簽署《便利廣東籍遊艇進出香港水域工作安排》及《香港遊艇入出廣東工作安排》。下周五的儀式將迎接首批經此新安排南下的廣東遊艇。
陳美寶又指，剛結束的國慶黃金周本港錄得逾160萬人次訪港，其中內地入境旅客超過141萬人次。新皇崗口岸將於10月12日早上6時30分正式開放予公眾使用。
當局正與廣東省政府商討，將「港車北上」逢星期二及星期三毋須預約的安排，逐步擴展至其他非繁忙工作日，以配合海路新措施促進雙向流動。
